name: @repo/auth-form
description: A presentation-only sign-in / sign-up form that reveals fields progressively and stays fully accessible.

useCases: Sign-in and sign-up pages with progressive field disclosure
Auth modals that morph between sign-in and sign-up
Password creation flows with live requirement feedback
compositionHints: Wire onSubmit to your own auth call — this component never authenticates
Pass status and error/fieldErrors from your form library or server response
Use with SmoothButton or custom footer content for legal text
